criteria.text: A virtual machine is restored from an immutable snapshot after a simulated ransomware encryption
criteria.how: Encrypt a test VM's disk, try to delete its snapshots as an administrator, then restore it and time the restore.

criteria.text: A planned failover to the secondary site meets the agreed recovery time and recovery point
criteria.how: Run the recovery plan on a test application and record the time to service and the data lost.

criteria.text: A host fails and its virtual machines restart elsewhere with no manual step
criteria.how: Power off one node during a load test and watch the workloads move.

criteria.text: A full software and firmware upgrade completes on a running cluster with no workload downtime
criteria.how: Upgrade a cluster carrying a test workload and check that it never stops serving.

criteria.text: A new virtual machine is provisioned by an application team through self-service within its quota
criteria.how: Have one team request and receive a VM without opening a ticket.

criteria.text: The capacity forecast names the month the cluster runs out of storage, and the team agrees with it
criteria.how: Compare the forecast with the team's own estimate and growth plan.
